title: Batch image compress output
description: Optimized image files in the default key-value store plus one dataset item per attempted image (metadata with bytesBefore/After, savedPct). SUMMARY/OUTPUT JSON in KV.

results.title: Compress metadata
results.description: Default dataset items: sourceUrl, status, format, contentType, bytesBefore, bytesAfter, savedPct, width, height, sha256, kvKey, strippedExif, errors, durationMs. Views: overview.

images.title: Optimized images (KV)
images.description: Binary image records under the configured kvKeyPrefix (default opt-).

summary.title: SUMMARY report
summary.description: Key-value store record SUMMARY (JSON): counts, charged, durationSecs, peakMemoryMb, avifSupported.

output.title: Run summary (OUTPUT)
output.description: Key-value store record OUTPUT (JSON): same run summary as SUMMARY plus charged event counts.
